title: Queen James: Passion, Plots and Power in the Court of Britain's First King
original_title: Queen James: Passion, Plots and Power in the Court of Britain's First King
overview: ‘Elizabeth was king, then James was queen.’ – Unknown English author (1623)  Gareth Russell, the author of Queen James: The Life and Loves of Britain’s First King, tells James’ story, focusing on a sensational murder trial that threatened to shake the monarchy to its core.
